content: उत्पद् €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To be born or produced, arise, originate, spring up; उत्पत्स्यतेऽस्ति मम कोऽपि समानधर्मा <ls>Māl. 1. 6</ls>; वायोर्ज्योतिरुत्पद्यते <ls>Ms. 1. 77</ls>. .²2 To occur, happen; उदपादि चास्य मनसि <ls>K. 132</ls> it occurred to his mind; युद्धमुत्पत्स्यते महत् <ls>Mb.</ls>; उत्पन्नावसरमर्थित्वम् <ls>M. 3</ls>. for which an occasion has presented itself; <ls>Ms. 5. 48</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To produce, beget, cause, effect, bring about, prepare; वस्त्राणि सदैवोत्पादयति <ls>Pt. 2</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 63</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">2. 147</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 60</ls>; so दुःखम्, दोषम्, भयम्, शङ्काम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To bring forward.
